result.title: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
result.summary: World models predict how an environment responds to actions, so that candidate actions can be evaluated before execution. Executed actions, or decisions, taken in this manner are only as reliable as the model's predictive capabilities, and predictions in turn are only reliable within the model's experience. Epistemic uncertainty (EU) is the signal that marks where that experience ends. In this work we offer an extensive empirical study on how training objectives and architectures shape epistemic uncertainty of world models. More precisely, we present a controlled comparison of post-hoc EU (last-layer Laplace and ensembles) between two dominant models of different paradigms: 1) LeWorldModel (LeWM): A joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), which predicts the next embedding without a decoder, and 2) DreamerV3: A recurrent state-space model (RSSM), which reconstructs the observation from a recurrent latent state. In ten simulated visual-control environments, we follow a controlled state perturbation of the environment state through every stage of the models up to the final EU estimate. We find that the RSSM attenuates the state perturbation through two mechanisms before it reaches an estimator on the predictor feature. Its recurrent update averages over context, so a change in a single frame reaches the state at a fraction of its size and recovers only as the change persists. Its reconstruction objective weights an entity by the pixels it covers, so a small object can be lost due to the training objective. The JEPA has neither mechanism and passes the change through all stages to the uncertainty. We further show that this translates to gaps in five uncertainty related downstream tasks, from unfamiliar-state detection to uncertainty-penalised planning: the RSSM uncertainty misses deviations that its own posterior registers, whereas the JEPA uncertainty reports what its model sees.

AI.brief_summary: 在十个视觉控制环境中逐阶段扰动环境状态，比较 JEPA（LeWorldModel）与 RSSM（DreamerV3）的训练目标与架构如何塑造事后 epistemic uncertainty 估计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「循环更新平均化单帧变化、重建目标按像素覆盖加权而丢失小实体」的诊断，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 状态中的保留与坍缩；在预测特征上做不确定性估计也可能为 STOP 与证据筛选提供线索。
